judge_context: A single, short Python script with a main guard, an explicit allow/deny policy (dangerous tags, on* attributes, dangerous URL schemes in URL-bearing attributes) kept in named constants, and URL normalisation (entity decoding, stripping control characters/whitespace) in one helper. Prefer a real parser (html.parser / bs4) or a carefully tokenising approach over chains of str.replace; no debug prints, and the file is read and written with an explicit encoding.

case_items.name: Obfuscated vectors neutralised
case_items.question: Does filter.py neutralise event-handler attributes regardless of case, whitespace or slash separators (e.g. <img/src=x OnError=...>), javascript:/vbscript:/data:text/html URLs even when entity-encoded or split by tabs/newlines (href, src, action, formaction, srcdoc, xlink:href), <svg>/<math>/<template>/<iframe>/<object>/<embed>/<base>/<meta http-equiv=refresh> vectors, and malformed or null-byte-split <script> tags?

criteria.perfect: All listed vector classes are neutralised by general rules (attribute-name and URL-scheme normalisation, element allow/deny logic), with no reliance on exact test strings.
criteria.accept: Most classes handled; one niche class (e.g. entity-encoded javascript: in srcdoc, or <math>/<svg> href) is not covered.
criteria.bad: Relies on literal, case-sensitive string replacement (e.g. only '<script' or 'onclick=') so simple case / whitespace / entity variations bypass it.

case_items.name: Minimal edits on dirty documents
case_items.name_zh: 含恶意内容的文档仅做最小修改
case_items.question: When a document does contain JavaScript, does filter.py remove only the harmful elements/attributes/URLs and leave the rest of the markup (benign attributes, text, structure, formatting) intact?

criteria.perfect: Only the dangerous elements/attributes/URLs are removed; the remaining markup keeps its original quoting, attribute order, whitespace and benign attributes (style, class, href to http(s), etc.).
criteria.accept: Dangerous parts removed but the whole document is re-serialised (e.g. via BeautifulSoup) with cosmetic changes such as quote style or self-closing tags.
criteria.bad: Strips benign content wholesale (e.g. empties <body>, removes all attributes, drops all links or images) or escapes entire documents to make them inert.
